title: In situ generation of Cu- and Ag–Sn alloys from metal sulfides for CO2 reduction
content:
Energy Adv., 2025, 4,657-665
DOI: 10.1039/D4YA00603H, Paper

Sebastian A. Sanden, Anne Schmidt, Miłosz Kożusznik, Yannik Haver, Yannick Weidemannn, Kevinjeorjios Pellumbi, Sven Rösler, Kai junge Puring, Andrzej Mikuła, Ulf-Peter Apfel
Bimetallic sulfide composites Cu3SnS4 and Ag3SnS4 outperform their monometallic counterparts SnS and Cu2S as CO2RR catalysts. The higher catalytic activity results from the formation of Cu3Sn and Ag3Sn alloys, where Ag3Sn is less prone to corrosion.
